cross_layer.title: VLAN 30: single-fiber uplink to a sole gateway
cross_layer.detail: VLAN 30's only L3 gateway is core1 (no FHRP); access1 Gi0/1 reach the fabric over a single non-redundant fiber.
cross_layer.recommendation: A single fiber cut isolates the VLAN with no L1 path and no L3 backup - add a redundant uplink AND an FHRP peer.

cross_layer.title: core1: stacked single point of failure across L1, L3
cross_layer.detail: core1 is implicated at multiple layers at once (L1, L3) - its loss compounds physical, switching, and/or routing failure.
cross_layer.recommendation: Treat as a top migration risk: stage redundancy at every implicated layer before cutover.

cross_layer.title: VLAN 30: sole gateway core1 with no FHRP
cross_layer.detail: core1 is the only in-scan L3 gateway for VLAN 30; loss drops the default gateway for every VLAN 30 host.
cross_layer.recommendation: Add an FHRP peer (HSRP/VRRP/GLBP) or confirm a redundant off-scan gateway.

cross_layer.title: core1: L1 fault on an L3 gateway switch
cross_layer.detail: core1 hosts L3 gateway SVIs and has an err-disabled or high-error port - physical instability at a routing aggregation point.
cross_layer.recommendation: Investigate the affected port; instability here affects every VLAN gatewayed by this switch.

protocol_intelligence.meaning: Adjacency stuck negotiating the DB-descriptor exchange; it never reaches FULL.
protocol_intelligence.likely_cause: Interface MTU mismatch between the neighbors (the classic cause); also blocked unicast (ACL/NAT) or a duplicate OSPF router-id.
protocol_intelligence.remediation: Match the IP MTU on both interfaces (or `ip ospf mtu-ignore` as a stopgap); verify unicast reachability and unique router-ids.
protocol_intelligence.confidence: observed state = fact; likely cause = Inferred (Cisco doctrine)

findings.title: Local user password storage

findings.remediation: Store local users with 'secret' (Type-8/9); remove Type-0/7 'password' entries.

findings.title: SNMP access
findings.detail: a default community (public/private); 1 v1/v2c community string(s) '<redacted>' -- v1/v2c carry the community in cleartext.
findings.remediation: Remove SNMPv1/v2c communities; use SNMPv3 with auth+priv (SHA/AES).

findings.title: VTY transport (telnet)

findings.title: VTY line hardening

findings.remediation: Apply an 'access-class' ACL and a non-zero 'exec-timeout' on every VTY line.
